**Are you a facilities management professional who wants to run a residential community like your own business, with the P&L in your hands?**

A premium home maintenance business is doing something different in the UAE. It doesn’t send vans out from one central depot. Instead, it puts a permanent team, an office and a fleet inside every villa community it serves, so residents get a response in minutes and see the same faces every visit. The business is backed by an established UK company with eight years in prime London residential. It opened in the UAE just over a year ago, already runs three communities, and plans a new one every two to three months. Now it’s hiring the Community Managers who will run them.

**What’s in it for you?**

* AED 17,000–23,000 per month, depending on experience
* Full ownership of your community: your team, your clients, your P&L and your own community account
* A direct line to the founder, with real autonomy and no layers in between
* Real room to grow as new communities open, in Abu Dhabi and Dubai
* A business small enough for you to shape, and backed well enough to support you

**What will you be doing?**

* Running one villa community end to end: service delivery, the field team, client relationships and the monthly P&L
* Leading a team of maintenance coordinators and field technicians
* Owning the client book: knowing every homeowner personally and owning every annual maintenance contract (AMC) renewal
* Scoping AMCs for each villa, meaning what it needs each year and how often
* Working with the sales team to convert non-contract clients into AMCs
* Being out in the community every day, not behind a desk
* Delivering the service standard the brand is built on, from response times to how each job is closed out
* Reporting your community’s numbers weekly and reviewing your P&L with the founder every month

**What do you need?**

* A facilities management background.
  This is essential.
* B2C experience with residential properties, specifically villas. B2B, or managing only the common areas of a community, isn’t enough on its own.
* A solid grasp of AMCs: how they’re scoped, priced and renewed
* Experience running a P&L yourself, not with someone above you doing it
* Strong operations skills and the initiative to take a community and run with it
* Fluent English. A second language is a bonus.
* Based in Dubai
* A UAE driving licence

*Don’t worry if your CV isn’t up to date. Share your LinkedIn profile and we’ll take it from there.*

Our client, a creative production agency, is looking for an experienced **Production Director (Build & Procurement)** to join its project team in Dubai. You’ll deliver a one-night immersive launch experience for a major international brand in January 2027. The engagement runs from **ASAP to 31 January 2027** and covers pre-production, build, show, de-rig and the post-event report.  
  
You will lead:

* The full physical build: a large climate-controlled temporary structure, themed scenic environments, multi-level activation zones and a branded facade.
* The procurement, tendering and supplier negotiation for every build package.
* The build budget, from target cost to final reconciliation.
* Site delivery, from design development through to handback.

This role is commercially driven. Every package is tendered, benchmarked and negotiated before it’s awarded. You’ll need to know what things really cost in the UAE market, challenge quotes line by line and get the best price and terms from suppliers without compromising quality, safety or the creative.

It’s a senior role but a very hands-on one. You’ll own the commercial strategy and also run the site day to day: daily meetings, crew supervision and long build days in a tight window.

Full project details will be shared once an NDA is signed.

**Key Responsibilities**

*Procurement and Supplier Negotiation*

* Set a target cost for each package before going to market, based on the approved budget and current market rates.
* Write detailed scopes and tender every package to at least three suppliers so quotes can be compared like for like.
* Negotiate price, payment terms and delivery dates, and push value engineering such as alternative materials, rental instead of build, and reuse of existing stock.
* Award work only on a fixed scope and fixed price, and track the savings made against first-round quotes.

*Budget Control and Variations*

* Own the build budget and keep a live cost tracker covering quoted, negotiated, committed and paid amounts.
* Prepare PO requests and track supplier payments with the Account and Finance teams.
* Challenge and negotiate every variation request, and make sure it’s approved before any extra work starts.

*Temporary Structure and Site*

* Manage the temporary structure supplier, the flooring systems and the sub-floor routing for services.
* Plan site logistics, including access, deliveries, laydown, BOH layout, crew welfare and security.
* Secure structural engineer sign-off and make sure the layout meets Civil Defence and venue safety rules.

*Scenic Build and Fit-Out*

* Lead the scenic suppliers delivering the themed landscapes, activation zones, show stage and branded facade.
* Review and approve shop drawings, samples and mock-ups, and check that what’s delivered matches what was quoted.
* Deliver the BOH areas, guest circulation, content capture zones, furniture, signage and finishes, and run snagging before rehearsals.

*Services and Technical Interfaces*

* Coordinate HVAC unit positions and duct routes, and design scenic concealment that still allows maintenance access.
* Coordinate the structure and scenic interfaces with the Technical Director, including rigging points, platforms and cable routes.

*Schedule, HSE and Handover*

* Build and run the master build and de-rig schedule for all non-technical works.
* Collect method statements, risk assessments, insurances and certificates, and manage permits with the venue and the authorities.
* Manage de-rig, waste removal and site reinstatement, then deliver a post-event report covering final costs against budget, savings achieved and lessons learned.

* At least 15 years in live events, brand activations or experiential production.
* At least 3 years in a Production Director role.
* Proven delivery of large temporary structures and themed scenic environments.
* A proven track record in procurement and cost reduction, with clear examples of savings you negotiated on past projects.

This is a governance role, not a data ownership role. This role is responsible for implementing and operationalising data governance across IT, in accordance with the Enterprise Data Governance framework, policies and standards. * Turn assessment findings into a sequenced backlog with named owners and see it through to completion.

Our tenants are major mobile network operators (MNOs), and we serve them across nine high-growth markets: eight in Africa and Oman in the Middle East. Our purpose, mission and sustainable business strategy are underpinned by our values of integrity, partnership and excellence.

**Overview**

Reporting into the Operations & Performance Engineering function, you will develop, govern and improve Group operational asset lifecycle strategies for telecommunications infrastructure assets. You will help ensure strong operational performance, reliability, safety, QHSE compliance and long-term value across the asset portfolio.

Working with Engineering, Operations, Finance, Procurement, IT and Maintenance Partners, you will lead lifecycle planning, asset performance optimisation, change governance, capital investment planning and asset information management. Approximately 6–12 times per year

* Developing Group lifecycle and governance strategies for power systems, shelters and associated infrastructure.
* Preparing and implementing long-term asset replacement, refurbishment and renewal plans.
* Establishing and governing asset refurbishment programmes across operating companies.

* Own the clash resolution activity for the group, end to end.
* Issue direction and provide the solution where a clash needs a decision.
* Agree the solution with the engineering team and establish which modeller carries the fix.
* Ensure interfaces and tie-ins between disciplines and with third parties are coordinated.

* Deliver internal training on the authoring tools, and confirm the group's capability against project requirements.

* Autodesk Construction Cloud or BIM 360, including model coordination spaces and package sharing.

* Data shortcuts, part catalogues, object styles and authoring templates at a level that lets the role set them for others.
* Local authority requirements in the UAE and Saudi Arabia, including utility depth, cover and corridor allocation standards.

* Degree in Civil Engineering, or a diploma with equivalent proven experience.
* Ten or more years in infrastructure design production, of which at least five supervising multiple teams or a large production team in an engineering consultancy.

* Middle East consultancy experience strongly preferred.
* Fluent written and spoken English.

* Takes the decision on a clash rather than letting it circulate.
* Plans resource ahead of demand rather than reacting to a shortfall.
* Develops people deliberately, and is judged on their progression.

* On-time issue of the group's deliverables against the agreed programme.
* Model and drawing checklist failures found after the role's own validation.
* Clash resolution rate and the ageing of open clashes in the group.
* Utilisation and bench time across the group against the deployment plan.

**Job Description:**

**1. Job Purpose**
------------------

To carry out all surveying, setting-out verification, and dimensional control activities ensuring that the Contractor's setting-out, levels, alignments, and as-built records comply with the approved IFC drawings, project specifications, and the requirements of the Client and relevant Dubai authorities (DM, RTA, DEWA). The Land Surveyor provides the Resident Engineer with independent verification of all survey-related works and ensures full traceability to the Dubai Local Transverse Mercator (DLTM) coordinate system and DMD (Dubai Municipality Datum) vertical datum.

**2. Key Responsibilities**
---------------------------

**2.1 Survey Control & Datum**

* Establish, verify, and maintain primary and secondary survey control networks on site, tied to DLTM and DMD via Dubai Municipality benchmarks.
* Carry out periodic verification of control stations to confirm stability and accuracy.
* Maintain the Project Control Register, including coordinates, elevations, descriptions, and check records.
* Verify the Contractor's survey control submissions and recommend approval to the Resident Engineer.

**2.2 Setting-Out Verification**

* Independently check the Contractor's setting-out of roads, bridges, tunnels, structures, drainage, and utility corridors against approved IFC drawings.
* Verify horizontal alignment, vertical alignment, cross-sections, super-elevation, gradients, and chainages.
* Sign off setting-out check sheets prior to commencement of works and maintain the setting-Out Register.
* Issue Survey Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) where setting out does not comply with approved drawings or tolerances.

**2.3 Roadworks Surveying**

* Verify levels and lines for subgrade, subbase, aggregate base course (ABC), and asphalt layers (binder and wearing course).
* Check kerbs, gullies, channels, manhole covers, road markings, and signage positions.
* Confirm camber, crossfall, super-elevation transitions, and gradient compliance with approved geometric design.
* Carry out asphalt level checks before and after paving to verify thickness compliance.

**2.4 Bridges & Structures**

* Verify setting-out and levels for piles, pile caps, piers, abutments, bearings, girders, deck slabs, parapets, and expansion joints.
* Check geometric control of formwork, falsework, and reinforcement positioning.
* Carry out monitoring surveys for movement, settlement, and deflection of structures during and after construction.
* Verify final geometry of bridge decks, including camber, alignment, and joint positions.

**2.5 Tunnels**

* Verify tunnel alignment control, including horizontal and vertical setting-out of the tunnel axis.
* Check setting-out for segmental linings, cross-passages, shafts, portals, and tunnel finishes.
* Carry out convergence and settlement monitoring of tunnel sections and surrounding structures.
* Coordinate with the Contractor's tunnel survey team on TBM guidance and as-built tunnel geometry.

**2.6 Infrastructure Utilities**

* Verify setting-out of water, sewerage, irrigation, district cooling, telecom, and electrical networks.
* Check trench alignment, invert levels, gradients, and connection points to existing utilities.
* Confirm chamber, manhole, and valve positions and levels.
* Coordinate with DEWA, DM Sewerage, Etisalat/du, and Empower surveyors during joint surveys and tie-ins.

**2.7 Topographic & Pre-Construction Surveys**

* Witness and verify topographic surveys, pre-construction condition surveys, and existing utility surveys carried out by the Contractor.
* Check existing levels, ground conditions, and surface features against design assumptions.
* Identify and report any discrepancies between design and existing site conditions to the Resident Engineer.

**2.8 Quantity Verification Support**

* Carry out joint surveys with the Contractor and Quantity Surveyor for measurement of earthworks (cut/fill), excavation, backfill, and pavement layers.
* Prepare cross-sections, longitudinal sections, and volume calculations using survey software (Civil 3D, AutoCAD, Trimble Business Center).
* Support the Quantity Surveyor with survey-based quantity verification for interim payment applications.

**2.9 As-Built Surveys & Records**

* Verify the Contractor's as-built surveys for all completed works and ensure compliance with project specifications and DM/RTA submission requirements.
* Check accuracy, completeness, and format of as-built drawings prior to recommendation for approval.
* Maintain a comprehensive As-Built Survey Register and ensure traceability to hand over documentation.

**2.10 Instruments & Calibration**

* Maintain Consultant's survey instruments (Total Stations, GNSS/RTK GPS, automatic and digital levels, prisms, and accessories) in good working order.
* Verify that all Contractor's survey instruments are calibrated by accredited laboratories with valid certificates.
* Maintain a Calibration Register for all survey equipment used on the project.

**2.11 Documentation & Reporting**

* Maintain comprehensive survey records: control sheets, setting out check sheets, level books, monitoring records, NCRs, and as-built data.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly survey activity reports for the Resident Engineer.
* Support authority audits and submissions to DM, RTA, and DEWA with verified survey data.

**2.12 Coordination & Reporting**

* Report directly to the Resident Engineer on all survey-related matters.
* Coordinate with Site Engineers, Materials Engineer, Quantity Surveyor, and the Contractor's Survey Manager and team.
* Attend technical meetings, progress reviews, and joint surveys with authorities.

**3. Qualifications & Experience**
----------------------------------

* **Education:** B.Sc. in Surveying / Geomatics / Civil Engineering, or a recognized Diploma in Land Surveying with relevant professional experience.
* **Experience:** Minimum 10 years' experience in land surveying on construction projects, with at least 7 years on major infrastructure projects (roads, bridges, tunnels, utilities) and a minimum of 3 years in the UAE/GCC.
* **Certifications:** Dubai Municipality / RTA approval as Land Surveyor is highly preferred.
* **Knowledge:** Dubai Local Transverse Mercator (DLTM) projection, DMD vertical datum, DM and RTA survey specifications, geometric design standards, and infrastructure construction tolerances.
* **Skills:** Expert use of Total Stations, GNSS/RTK GPS, digital levels, and 3D laser scanners. Strong proficiency in AutoCAD, Civil 3D. Good technical report writing, attention to detail, and effective communication.

**4. Reporting Line**
---------------------

The Land Surveyor reports directly to the Resident Engineer and works in close coordination with the Assistant Resident Engineer, Site Engineers, Materials Engineer, Quantity Surveyor, and the Contractor's Survey Manager and survey team.

* For Key Accounts, the role emphasises executive relationship management, retention, governance, service oversight, and disciplined profitable revenue to increase and maintain NRR for Key Accounts at or above 100%
* For High-Potential accounts, the role requires stronger commercial intensity, proactively identifying, qualifying, and progressing expansion opportunities while protecting service quality and retention to grow accounts to deliver NRR in excess of 125% for High-Potential accounts

**Core Responsibilities**
Achieve strong Net Revenue Retention levels for the client portfolio under management by delivering on the following core responsibilities:
  
  

* Develop and maintain account plans that reflect client priorities, whitespace opportunities, stakeholder maps, risk areas, and agreed growth actions

* Business Developers (BDs)/Subject Matter Experts (SMEs):

+ Partner with Service Delivery leaders to monitor service performance, address risks, and identify opportunities to deepen the client relationship

**Success Measures (KPIs)**

* Existence and maintenance of Endgame account plans for all assigned accounts
* Net Revenue Retention: being the Net Revenue for your nominated accounts in the most recent financial period compared to the corresponding prior year period (i.e. the aggregate of prior period revenues plus product and country cross-sell, plus upsell, less client attrition, less product and country downsell, less downsell; divided by the prior period revenues – all as defined in the SAC BI Revenue Bridge)

* Cash collections (and as a consequence its precursor, billing)
* Client satisfaction, based on CSAT and NPS scores
* The timeliness, completeness and accuracy of data relating to opportunities, contract wins, customers, customer projects and work packages

**Experience**
**Requirements & Profile**

Role summary

The Cafe Supervisor runs each shift at Escena Cafe so that every guest gets fast, consistent service and every shift closes with balanced cash, accurate stock and a clean, compliant kitchen and floor. You lead the baristas, servers and kitchen team on shift, act as the Cafe Manager's deputy, and are measured on the KPIs set out below.

Key responsibilitiesShift running

* Run the shift plan: assign stations, set break times and redeploy staff during peaks.
* Hold a 5-minute pre-shift briefing on specials, stock-outs, bookings and targets.
* Monitor ticket times and step in on the bar or floor when queues build.
* Complete the shift handover log before leaving.

Team leading

* Supervise baristas, servers and kitchen staff on shift, typically 4 to 8 people.
* Train new starters on recipes, service standards and the POS within their first 2 weeks.
* Give on-the-spot coaching and flag performance or attendance issues to the Cafe Manager.
* Help the Cafe Manager build the weekly rota and approve shift swaps.

Opening and closing

* Open and close the cafe using the opening and closing checklists, signed off every day.
* Check equipment (espresso machine, grinders, fridges, ovens) and log faults the same day.
* Make sure the cafe is ready for guests at the published opening time.
* Secure the premises, cash and alarm at close.

Cash and stock control

* Count floats, run end-of-day POS reports and reconcile cash and card takings.
* Approve voids, refunds and discounts within agreed limits.
* Run daily spot counts on high-value items (coffee, milk, dairy alternatives, pastries) and the weekly full stock count.
* Log all waste and place supplier orders against par levels.
* Receive deliveries and check quantity, quality and temperature against the invoice.

Food safety and hygiene

* Enforce Dubai Municipality food safety rules and the cafe's HACCP-based food safety plan.
* Complete temperature logs for fridges, freezers and deliveries every shift.
* Make sure every food handler holds a valid Dubai Municipality occupational health card and required food safety training.
* Enforce cleaning schedules, allergen controls, labelling and FIFO stock rotation.
* Lead the team during Dubai Municipality inspections and close any findings by the deadline given.

Customer service

* Set and model Escena's service standards on the floor.
* Handle complaints on the spot and log any that need follow-up.
* Monitor online reviews and delivery-app ratings with the Cafe Manager.
* Look after regulars and drive upselling of add-ons, pastries and retail items.

**Description**
You will lead analytics for the
**Services**
cluster — the set of domains that protect trust, safety, and quality across every interaction on our platform. This is where the integrity of the marketplace is safeguarded and where millions of passengers and drivers experience inDrive as a safe and reliable place to be. Your teams will span five closely connected areas:
**Watchdocs**
(driver document verification and work with the compliance base),
**Trust & Safety**
(everything related to trust and safety in rides — incidents and safety features),
**Customer Support**
(both the product tooling for handling user requests and the automation of that work, plus WFM analytics of support agents performance),
**Customer Experience**
(Voice-of-the-Customer feedback and connecting satisfaction metrics such as CSAT/DSAT to business metrics), and
**Antifraud**
(protecting rides, transactions, ratings, and more from abuse across inDrive).
  
  
You will build and manage a team that partners closely with
**product, operations, support, and compliance**
to turn a large volume of behavioral, operational, and feedback signals into decisions that reduce risk and improve experience at the same time. From detecting and quantifying fraud across rides and transactions, to measuring the real business impact of safety features and support automation, to linking customer-feedback metrics (CSAT/DSAT) with core business outcomes — your work will define how the company balances protection, cost, and user satisfaction.
  
  
In this role, you will act as a
**strategic partner**
to product and business leaders, as well as to Trust & Safety and Compliance stakeholders — shaping the analytics agenda for the Services cluster, defending its strategy in front of senior leadership, and building scalable processes, metrics, and standards that make trust and safety measurable across the whole platform.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Own the analytics strategy and roadmap for the Services cluster (Watchdocs, Trust & Safety, Customer Support, CX, Antifraud), align it with company-level priorities, and defend it in front of senior leadership
* Build, grow, and develop a team of 11+ (analysts) — hiring, mentoring, and setting quality standards across the cluster
* Lead Antifraud analytics: detect and quantify fraudulent behavior across rides, transactions, and ratings; evaluate the effectiveness of anti-fraud rules and models and their trade-off with false positives
* Drive Trust & Safety analytics: measure incident rates, evaluate the impact of safety features, and help prioritize initiatives that reduce risk for passengers and drivers
* Oversee Customer Support analytics: assess support tooling and automation effectiveness, contact-rate drivers, resolution quality, and WFM analytics for agent capacity and performance
* Lead CX analytics: connect Voice-of-the-Customer metrics (CSAT/DSAT) to business outcomes such as retention and revenue, and turn feedback into prioritized product and operational actions
* Guide Watchdocs analytics: the document-verification funnel, compliance coverage, and the balance between compliance rigor and a smooth driver onboarding experience
* Define and standardize metrics, definitions, and monitoring across the cluster; ensure data quality in partnership with DWH, DS, and Engineering
* Establish best practices in experimentation (A/B testing), causal inference, forecasting, and effect measurement across the team
* Partner cross-functionally at the company level (Product & Tech & Business, DWH, DS, Engineering) and act as a trusted advisor to Head / Director / C-suite stakeholders

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise
  
  

* 6+ years of experience in data or product analytics, preferably in tech, ride-hailing, marketplace, or platform businesses
* 2+ years of people management, leading teams of 10+ people, including other managers or team leads
* Strong expertise in SQL and Python (or R), with a solid foundation in statistics and experimentation (A/B testing, causal inference)
* Proven ability to translate large volumes of behavioral, operational, and feedback data into decisions that balance risk, cost, and user experience
* Experience partnering with senior stakeholders (Head / Director / C-suite) and forming and defending strategy at the company level
* Proficiency in BI tools (Tableau, Looker, Redash, or similar)
* Strong communication skills and the ability to present complex findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
* English proficiency at B2 or higher for international collaboration

**Nice to Have**

* Hands-on experience in one of the Services domains — Trust & Safety, Antifraud, Customer Support / WFM, CX / Voice-of-the-Customer, or compliance
* Experience with fraud / risk modeling, anomaly detection, or safety analytics
* Familiarity with text / sentiment analysis for customer-feedback data
* Experience scaling analytics across multiple countries and verticals

* Engage in company-wide challenges, awards, sports activities, employee-led social impact and volunteering projects
* Work alongside people who take initiative, speak openly, and challenge themselves to grow
* Improve your language skills through co-financed courses and internal speaking clubs

## \*1. Job Purpose\*

To perform preventive and corrective maintenance, troubleshooting, inspection, and repair of all Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing (MEP), and Air Conditioning (AC) systems across company facilities, ensuring smooth operations, equipment reliability, energy efficiency, and workplace safety.

## \*2. Key Responsibilities\*

### \*A. Air Conditioning (AC) & HVAC Maintenance\*

1. Perform regular inspection and preventive maintenance of all split AC, package AC, central AC and HVAC systems.

2. Clean and replace AC filters as per the maintenance schedule.

3. Clean evaporator and condenser coils.

4. Inspect and clean AC drainage lines and drain trays to prevent water leakage.

5. Check refrigerant gas pressure and identify refrigerant leakage.

6. Inspect compressors, thermostats, fan motors and control systems.

7. Check AC cooling performance and maintain the required temperature.

8. Troubleshoot AC breakdowns, cooling problems and abnormal noise.

9. Inspect ducting, insulation, air diffusers and ventilation systems.

10. Monitor AC electricity consumption and report abnormal readings.

11. Coordinate with specialist AC contractors for major repairs and gas charging when required.

12. Maintain AC maintenance records for all branches.

### \*B. Electrical Maintenance\*

1. Inspect and maintain electrical distribution boards (DBs).

2. Repair electrical wiring, switches, sockets and lighting.

3. Troubleshoot electrical faults and power failures.

4. Inspect circuit breakers, isolators and electrical protection systems.

5. Support PAT testing and electrical safety inspections.

6. Monitor electrical load distribution.

7. Report electrical hazards and abnormalities.

### \*C. Mechanical & Kitchen Equipment Maintenance\*

1. Maintain commercial kitchen equipment.

2. Inspect refrigerators, freezers, chillers and cooling equipment.

3. Maintain pumps, motors and exhaust fans.

4. Inspect ventilation and fresh-air systems.

5. Troubleshoot mechanical breakdowns.

6. Coordinate specialist equipment repairs when required.

### \*D. Plumbing Maintenance\*

1. Repair water leakage and damaged pipes.

2. Maintain water pumps, valves and water supply systems.

3. Repair taps, sinks and washbasins.

4. Inspect drainage systems and clear blockages.

5. Maintain kitchen plumbing and sanitary fittings.

### \*E. Preventive & Corrective Maintenance\*

1. Follow daily, weekly and monthly maintenance schedules.

2. Attend maintenance complaints from all branches.

3. Respond to emergency maintenance requests.

4. Complete maintenance work orders within the agreed timeframe.

5. Identify recurring equipment problems.

6. Maintain records of maintenance activities.

7. Submit spare-parts and material requests to Procurement.

### \*F. Health & Safety\*

1. Follow company HSE policies and UAE safety requirements.

2. Use appropriate PPE.

3. Follow Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) procedures.

4. Obtain Permit to Work (PTW) before controlled maintenance activities.

5. Follow safe refrigerant handling procedures.

6. Report unsafe conditions and maintenance hazards.

 **Job Description**

To lead/ supervise individual Governance and Support Services Internal audits, as part of the approved Internal Audit Plan in order to contribute to providing reasonable assurance that Masdar’s internal controls promote efficiency, effectiveness and reduce the risk of loss, as well as help ensure the compliance with applicable Laws and Regulations.

**Responsibilities** :

* Lead audit engagements from the planning phase to the reporting phase to ensure deliver high-quality audit reports and timely completion of audit engagements.
* Perform internal audit or advisory engagements covering governance (relating to Head Office, Platforms, Operating Assets and SPVs etc.) and support functions (such as Finance, Procurement, IT, Business Support, Strategy, Performance management etc.) with an objective to add value, enhance efficiency, and effectiveness of underlying processes, and recommend best practices.
* Utilize advanced data analytics techniques to identify patterns, trends, and anomalies in financial and operational data as part of audit and advisory engagements.
* Prepare /review the Risk and Control Matrix (RCM) prior to the start of the fieldwork and in line with the project time plan and submit to the quality reviewer/ senior management for approval.
* Execute or supervise execution of all tests in accordance with approved RCM and within the agreed timelines.
* Identify and document the audit observations in the work papers.
* Perform regular supervisory review of the work papers prepared by assigned audit team members/ co-sourced service provider.
* Submit the draft audit report to senior management for review in line with the project time plan.
* Review the work and observations of assigned audit team members/ co-sourced service provider, to assess if further examination of additional areas, including technical aspects, is needed for an accurate portrayal of the company's commercial health.
* Develop and submit work papers for review to quality reviewer.
* Develop audit preclosing presentation and present observations to auditee.
* Prepare draft audit reports to meet the desired quality and standards.
* Manage audit closing meetings, ensure final reports meet the desired quality and standards, and submit to the quality reviewer, Director, Internal Audit Assurance, Governance and Support Services and Group Executive Director, Internal Audit for final quality review and issuance.
* Ensure that work papers are complete and uploaded in the internal audit database/ software.
* Review work papers prepared by service providers for work completeness, meeting the objectives, and matching it against issues that are identified.
* Submit the draft issues to the line manager for review in accordance with the project time plan.
* Perform /review regular follow-up audit engagements on the due management actions agreed as part of the final audit reports.
* Submit the follow-up work including draft follow-up report to engagement lead/ quality reviewer.
* Ensure compliance to requirements of “Continuous Monitoring” mentioned within Masdar QAIP manual.
* Support the audit team in performing “periodic self-assessments” to validate its continued conformance with the Global Internal Audit Standards and Code of Ethics.
* Participate in the annual risk assessment exercise by meeting process owners and reviewing underlying documents to develop/ update risk registers and validate the same with process owners.
* Participate in development of Internal Audit Plan in line with the results of annual risk assessment exercise.
* Build and maintain a network of relevant contacts to support daily activities and long-term objectives of the team.
* Engage with and monitor relationships with internal and external stakeholders in order to ensure adequate knowledge transfer and completion of services as per agreed parameters.
* Manage client relationships on individual assignments and ensure achievement of targeted percentage on audit satisfaction survey issued after the completion of the audit.
* Prepare relevant reports and updates (Internal Audit Plan progress update, Management/ ARCC update) as required and to the desired standard.
* Provide management information as and when required by the line manager – this includes the production and timely provision of accurate reports in line with reporting schedules.
* Implement approved Internal Audit Department policies, processes and procedures to ensure that work is carried out in a controlled and consistent manner while delivering a quality service to customers and stakeholders.

  
**Qualifications**

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* CPA, ACA, ACCA, ACAEW, MBA Finance.
* Certification such as ACA, ACCA, ACAEW, CPA, or CIA is an asset.

**Preferred Experience**:

* At least 10 years of experience in audit and advisory roles with majority of the experience gained in Big 4 Audit Firms with specialization in corporate governance, entity level reviews, support function audits including but not limited to strategy, performance management, finance, procurement, business support, IT etc.

**Job-Specific Skills:**

* Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills leading to a consultative approach within a corporate / multifunctional environment.
* Ability to manage cross-functional teams.
* Advanced IT skills, including proficiency in data analytics tools and software such as Power BI, audit based analytical tools, AI tools and ERP.
* Good knowledge of and skill in providing advisory and audit engagements for large scale greenfield, brownfield/ M&A project investment valuation, financial due diligence and building investment cases.
* Strong analytical and critical thinking skills, with the ability to interpret complex financial information and identify key insights.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, and Word, as well as data visualization tools such as Power BI.

The role is responsible for providing strategic and operational leadership for IT Service Operations, ensuring seamless, reliable and high-quality IT services across the organization. The position involves managing service management and support desk teams, overseeing incident and problem management, monitoring IT service performance, and ensuring compliance with agreed SLAs, security policies and regulatory standards.
  
  
The successful candidate will work closely with internal IT teams, vendors and business stakeholders to optimize service delivery, improve operational efficiency, manage IT procurement and assets, and implement data-driven monitoring practices. The role will also serve as the escalation point for critical IT service challenges and represent the Service Operations function in strategic and executive-level discussions.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Oversee end-to-end IT service operations, ensuring efficient, responsive and high-quality IT support while maintaining service continuity and operational performance.
* Lead and manage service management and support desk teams, ensuring effective resource utilization, team performance and adherence to ITIL best practices.
* Establish and oversee incident and problem management processes to minimize service disruptions, improve resolution timelines and ensure effective root cause analysis.
* Act as the escalation point for major incidents, critical service failures and complex IT operational challenges, ensuring timely resolution and stakeholder communication.
* Monitor IT service performance, infrastructure health and operational metrics through data-driven monitoring, analytics and reporting to proactively identify and address potential issues.
* Ensure compliance with agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs), Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), service quality standards and operational objectives.
* Drive IT procurement and asset management practices, including cost optimization, vendor management, technology acquisition and asset lifecycle management.
* Collaborate with internal IT teams, external vendors and business stakeholders to strengthen communication, coordination and overall service delivery.
* Develop and implement continuous improvement initiatives to enhance IT service quality, operational efficiency and customer satisfaction.
* Ensure IT service operations comply with organizational policies, IT governance frameworks, security requirements, risk management practices and applicable regulatory standards.
* Identify opportunities for process automation, operational optimization and innovation in IT service management.
* Drive team development through appropriate training, tools, knowledge-sharing initiatives and adoption of industry best practices.
* Represent the Service Operations function in executive and stakeholder meetings, presenting operational performance, highlighting risks and recommending strategic improvements.
* Advocate for appropriate resource allocation, technology investments and process enhancements to support business objectives.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related discipline. A Master's degree or MBA is preferred.
* Significant experience in IT Service Operations, IT Service Management, IT Infrastructure Management or Service Delivery leadership roles.
* Proven experience leading service management, IT support and service desk teams in large-scale enterprise environments.
* Strong knowledge of ITIL frameworks and IT Service Management processes, including Incident, Problem, Change and Service Request Management.
* Demonstrated expertise in SLA/KPI management, service performance monitoring, major incident management and operational reporting.
* Experience in IT infrastructure monitoring, service analytics, availability management and business continuity practices.
* Strong understanding of IT governance, risk management, information security and regulatory compliance requirements.
* Experience in IT procurement, vendor management, budgeting, contract management and IT asset lifecycle management.
* Proven ability to drive operational transformation, process improvements, service optimization and customer experience initiatives.
* Experience managing external service providers, technology partners and cross-functional stakeholder relationships.
* Strong strategic planning, decision-making and problem-solving capabilities.
* Relevant certifications such as ITIL 4, PMP, COBIT, ISO 20000 or other IT Service Management certifications will be an advantage.
* Experience working in large enterprise, government or regulated environments will be preferred.

* Self Confidence

* Mentorship

* Ensure readiness and cleanliness standards for all recreational areas, equipment, restrooms, locker rooms, pool decks, and common customer spaces.
* Develop, coordinate, and publish 90‑day lookahead calendars and monthly event calendars for fitness, pool, lounge, CAC, and theater activities in accordance with PWS requirements.
* Coordinate advertising materials, marketing flyers, talking papers, registration sheets, and promotional content with EFSS Marketing.
* Ensure all events are properly cross‑marketed across AUAB distribution channels to maximize participation.
* Lead customer engagement strategies, including QR-code feedback systems, surveys, After‑Action Reports, and customer communication.

------------

AtkinsRéalis is seeking a highly skilled ICT Engineer to support the delivery of a prestigious mega infrastructure and landscape development project in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This large-scale program encompasses smart city infrastructure, telecommunications networks, fiber optic systems, data communication infrastructure, Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS), security systems, command and control facilities, and digital technology platforms that form the backbone of a connected urban environment.

The ICT Engineer will play a key role in the planning, design review, coordination, construction supervision, testing, and commissioning of Information and Communication Technology (ICT) systems across the project. Working within the PMCM team, you will ensure that ICT infrastructure is delivered in accordance with project requirements, international standards, operational needs, and future smart city objectives. The role requires close collaboration with multidisciplinary teams, contractors, utility providers, technology vendors, and stakeholders to deliver robust, scalable, and secure communication networks and digital infrastructure solutions.

**Your role**
-------------

  

* Review and assess ICT designs, drawings, specifications, network architectures, and technical submissions for infrastructure and landscape-related projects.
* Provide technical oversight of ICT infrastructure works during construction to ensure compliance with approved designs, standards, and project requirements.
* Support the delivery of telecommunications networks, fiber optic infrastructure, structured cabling systems, wireless communication networks, and associated ICT assets.
* Review contractor shop drawings, material submissions, installation methodologies, testing procedures, and commissioning plans.
* Coordinate ICT interfaces with smart city systems, ITS, SCADA, security systems, public Wi-Fi, command centers, and utility communication networks.
* Conduct site inspections and monitor ICT installation activities to verify quality, safety, and compliance with project specifications.
* Participate in design reviews, technical workshops, constructability assessments, and multidisciplinary coordination meetings.
* Support testing, commissioning, integration, and operational readiness activities for ICT systems and communication networks.
* Monitor project progress and provide technical input on schedule performance, quality objectives, risks, and mitigation measures.
* Review network infrastructure requirements, data center interfaces, redundancy strategies, and system resilience measures.
* Liaise with utility providers, telecom operators, contractors, consultants, authorities, and client representatives regarding ICT requirements and approvals.
* Identify technical challenges, interface conflicts, and project risks while providing practical engineering solutions.
* Prepare technical reports, review comments, inspection records, engineering assessments, and progress updates.
* Ensure compliance with project standards, cybersecurity requirements, local regulations, industry best practices, and PMCM governance procedures.

**About you**
-------------

  

* Bachelor's degree in Telecommunications Engineering, ICT Engineering, Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 8-15 years of experience in ICT engineering, telecommunications infrastructure, smart city technologies, or large-scale infrastructure projects.
* Proven experience delivering ICT and telecommunications systems on major infrastructure, transportation, utilities, public realm, or urban development projects.
* Strong knowledge of fiber optic networks, structured cabling systems, passive and active network infrastructure, wireless communications, and ICT design principles.
* Experience with smart city technologies, Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS), command and control systems, surveillance systems, and integrated communication networks.
* Familiarity with international ICT and telecommunications standards such as TIA/EIA, BICSI, IEEE, ISO, IEC, and applicable local regulations.
* Experience reviewing technical specifications, engineering drawings, contractor submissions, shop drawings, and network architecture designs.
* Knowledge of cybersecurity principles, network redundancy, disaster recovery planning, and operational resilience strategies.
* Proficiency in ICT design tools, AutoCAD, BIM platforms, telecommunications planning software, and digital collaboration systems.
* Strong understanding of construction supervision, testing, commissioning, quality assurance, and project delivery processes.
* Excellent analytical, communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
* Experience working within PMCM, engineering consultancy, owner representative, or client-side organizations is highly desirable.
* GCC project experience, particularly within Saudi Arabia and large-scale smart infrastructure developments, is preferred.
* Professional certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, BICSI RCDD, PMP, or equivalent ICT-related credentials are advantageous.

Job Purpose
  
  
The Product Owner owns the backlog, roadmap and delivery outcomes for an assigned capability or product within Market-Creating Innovation (MCI). Depending on business need, the Product Owner may be assigned to a capability progressing through MCI's Explore pipeline (Evaluate, Validate and Accelerate) or to a product operating within MCI's Exploit pipeline; the core accountabilities, standards and ways of working for the role are the same regardless of assignment, allowing Product Owners to move between pipelines as priorities shift.
  
  
Reporting to the Director of Emerging Technology and AI, the Product Owner translates validated opportunities, business objectives and stakeholder needs into a clear, prioritized backlog of epics, features and user stories, and works closely with the Development team and Scrum Master/Agile Coach to deliver high-value increments each sprint.
  
  
The Product Owner acts as the connective link between business stakeholders, technical delivery and MCI's governance framework, ensuring the capability or product they own stays aligned to strategic priorities, meets quality and readiness standards at each relevant stage gate, and continues to deliver measurable value once live.
  
  
This role will also model and carry out World Vision Canada's mission, vision, strategies and Christian values through personal and professional conduct, demonstrating integrity, stewardship, collaboration and a commitment to serving others.
  
  
Responsibilities
  
  
Backlog Ownership & Prioritization (35%)
  

* Own and maintain the product backlog for the assigned capability or product, translating validated opportunities, business objectives and user needs into clear epics, features and user stories.
* Define and communicate a compelling product vision and roadmap for the assigned capability or product, aligned with MCI's mission and the relevant pipeline stage.
* Prioritize backlog items based on value, feasibility, risk, dependencies and strategic alignment, adjusting as new information or stakeholder feedback emerges.
* Define clear acceptance criteria and success measures for backlog items in partnership with business stakeholders and the Development team.
* Identify dependencies, risks and sequencing considerations across the backlog, and escalate trade-offs that require business or governance input.

Agile Delivery & Team Leadership (25%)
  

* Actively participate in and help lead agile ceremonies — including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint review, retrospectives and release planning — in partnership with the Scrum Master/Agile Coach.
* Partner with the Development team throughout the sprint to clarify requirements, answer questions and unblock delivery.
* Plan and coordinate releases, including defining release goals, managing dependencies, and confirming that releases meet quality and readiness standards before launch.
* Mentor and support the Development team, fostering a collaborative environment where ideas are valued and continuous improvement is encouraged.

Stakeholder & Value Management (20%)
  

* Serve as the primary point of contact and “voice of the product” for the assigned capability or product, engaging stakeholders to gather feedback and validate direction.
* Set and manage stakeholder expectations for delivery, proactively identifying and communicating barriers, and negotiating scope, timeline or resourcing trade-offs as required.
* Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) that measure the value and adoption of the assigned capability or product, using data and feedback to inform backlog decisions.
* Report progress, outcomes and risks to the Director and relevant governance forums on a regular cadence.

Quality, Governance & Stage Readiness (20%)
  

* Ensure the assigned capability or product meets MCI's quality, documentation and readiness standards at each relevant stage gate (e.g., Evaluate, Validate, Accelerate, Transfer) or, for Exploit-stage products (e.g., crawl, walk and run activities), ongoing operational and performance standards.

* Maintain accurate documentation of decisions, scope changes and roadmap updates for the assigned capability or product.
* Support the transition of capabilities between pipeline stages (e.g., Explore to Exploit) or the handoff to operational ownership, ensuring continuity of context and priorities.

At UBC, we believe that attracting and sustaining a diverse workforce is key to the successful pursuit of excellence in research, innovation, and learning for all faculty, staff and students. Our commitment to employment equity helps achieve inclusion and fairness, brings rich diversity to UBC as a workplace, and creates the necessary conditions for a rewarding career.
  
  
**Job Description Summary**
The Director of Customer Services and Informatics is a senior leadership position within UBC Facilities. The Director provides strategic leadership for Facilities customer service function, customer service plan, business project management, business analysis, informatics, enterprise maintenance management system (EMMS), facilities information and inventory systems, change management, call centre management and clerical support services. This role develops strategic objectives, implements and monitors procedures and policies that enable Facilities to meet or exceed agreed customer service standards across the entire campus. In addition, this division provides all business units within Facilities the necessary business support both by providing the necessary analytics and analysis to ensure continuous improvements continue across the department. The Director is responsible for the development and sustainment of the Facilities Emergency Management Plan.
  
  
The Director of Customer Services and Informatics is the Facilities representative for customer engagement, business projects and initiatives, space inventory data, building and infrastructure records drawings and information, analytics, reporting, technology and continuous improvement initiatives. They partner with Information Technology (IT) and Safety and Risk Services (SRS) - Emergency Management, Project Management Office (PMO), Integrated Service Centre (ISC), Communications & Engagement for strategic alignment and resource allocation.
  
  
The Director leads a workforce of approximately 35 staff in professional and unionized positions. Prepares strategic and business plans and supports an annual Facilities budget of approximately $150M.
  
  
**Organizational Status**
This position reports directly to the Associate Vice-President, Facilities, and serves as a member of the Facilities Leadership team. Works closely with other Directors, Senior Managers, and Managers as well as other department‘s leadership teams. This position is the senior leader within Facilities responsible for implementing business transformational initiatives with the support of other divisions, monitoring operational progress through the analysis and reporting of information to guide evidence-based decision-making.
  
  
**Work Performed**

* Provides strategic leadership to the Facilities Leadership team through the Customer Services and Informatics division to execute a full range of department-wide services to meet targets and objectives of the Strategic Plan. This includes supporting and developing business plans; ensuring consistent and effective implementation; enhancing integration; standardizing services and business practices; maximizing efficiencies and cost savings.
* Responsible for business transformational projects through assessment, analysis, design and implementation; champions the implementation of change management initiatives, process and execution.
* Leads the development of a Monitoring Framework with key performance indicators for each unit within the department and develops remedial and continuous improvement plans in relation to results. This framework includes leading and lagging indicators and an effective client satisfaction monitoring and reporting system to evaluate the services provided by the entire Facilities group.
* Leads the facilities information and inventory systems function, including university space inventory data, building and infrastructure record drawings, key plans, emergency response plans, and maintenance manuals.
* Provides direction and implements change management methodologies to effectively lead and optimize key projects across Facilities.
* Mentors and coaches change management in relation to the implementation of business initiatives.
* Liaises with academic, administrative and ancillary customers, engineers, architects and external clients to ensure that the facilities needs of the university are being met.
* Supports and provides direction to the Senior Facilities Manager in providing strategic leadership to the Facilities Managers working in the geographic zone model. Through the Senior Facilities Manager, oversees the delivery of equal, consistent and effectively prioritized service delivery within the campus zones.
* Provides strategic leadership on sustainment of Facilities and University information systems in support of enterprise maintenance management, asset management, stores inventory, space inventory, records drawings, records management, and project management.
* Provides strategic leadership and/or oversees development of innovative business solutions and services that integrate data and reporting capabilities to augment decision-making.
* Oversees work of various teams performing quality testing of data and information and reconciling across sources, presenting facts and evidence in dashboards to assist in effective evidence-based decision making.
* Provides strategic leadership to the Facilities Service Centre who are responsible for handling inbound and outbound calls regarding buildings and grounds.
* Responsible for administrative/clerical support services for the Facilities group.
* Provides direction in the completion of regulatory and skills development training for all staff within Facilities which includes developing plans, implementing and evaluating, department-wide strategies.
* Leads and directs the development of the Facilities Emergency Management Plan, including emergency preparedness exercises for the department in collaboration with SRS, Emergency Management.
* Works with SRS and implements consistent health, safety and environmental initiatives, which, includes safety committee, accident investigations, safety training and safety recommendations within the Customer Services and Informatics division.
* Responsible for human resource practices including recruitment, orientation, training, performance evaluation, discipline, labor relations and dismissal within the Customer Services and Informatics division in collaboration with Human Resources.
* Performs other related duties, including but not limited to:

+ Representing Facilities on various university committees. Develops working relationships and partnerships with key stakeholders across UBC.
+ Acting on behalf of the Associate Vice-President, Facilities.

Trillium Health Partners is one of Canada’s largest community-based teaching hospitals, serving the growing and diverse populations of Mississauga, West Toronto, and surrounding communities through the Credit Valley Hospital, the Mississauga Hospital, the Queensway Health Centre, the Reactivation care Centre (Church Site) and the new THP-UHN Reactivation Care Centre. Guided by our values of compassion, excellence, and courage, and through our strategic roadmap, Plan to 2030 , we are creating a new kind of health care - defined not by illness, but by the health and well-being of people and communities.
  
  
The Mississauga Halton Central West (MHCW) Regional Cancer Program (RCP) is one of 14 Regional Cancer Programs responsible for championing and influencing system transformation to drive performance of the cancer system and the region. The MHCW RCP, in alignment with Ontario Health-Cancer Care Ontario (OH-CCO), oversees the delivery and quality of cancer services for over 2 million residents across Mississauga Halton and Central West, including Etobicoke, Mississauga, Halton Hills, Oakville, Milton, Georgetown, Bolton, Brampton, Caledon, Malton, Orangeville, Rexdale, Shelburne and Woodbridge.
  
  
**Position Overview**
As the Regional Cancer Program Director for the Mississauga Halton Central West Regional Cancer Program, you will report to the Regional Vice President. A broad and influential leadership role that includes both a regional and programmatic mandate, you will lead regional planning and performance improvement in one of the largest regional cancer programs in the province. The Regional Director leads an inter-professional team providing system and regional leadership, relationship management, performance management and financial and risk management for cancer services across the region. Cancer Services include Systemic Treatment, Radiation Therapy, Surgical Oncology, Cancer Imaging, Pathology & Lab Medicine, Prevention, Cancer Screening, Primary Care, Psycho-social Oncology, Patient Education, and Survivorship. Additionally, the role provides integration and engagement/support for the Regional Endoscopy Services, Complex Malignant Haematology, Regional Cancer Informatics and Patient Experience across 4 hospitals partners (10 hospital sites), and 34 OSBP sites.
  
  
The Regional Director, in collaboration with the Regional Vice President and in alignment with the Ontario Cancer Plan 6, will lead the delivery of strategic initiatives to ensure quality care for patients and their families, and will play a vital role in building and sustaining excellence in regional service delivery.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**

* Develop and implement key strategic initiatives aligned with the Ontario Cancer Plan linked with the MHCW RCP’s strategic plan, goals and objectives
* Build high performing teams that implement local and regional aspects of the Ontario Cancer Plan
* Implement the clinical quality improvement agenda of the provincial program for all cancer clinical service delivery areas
* Establish and maintain operational partnerships in the region necessary to advance cancer system performance and priorities as well as jointly develop solutions to cancer system and related challenges
* Together with the RVP, facilitate cancer service capacity planning within the Regional Cancer Program and as part of province-wide cancer planning.
* Together with the RVP, build and maintain relationships with a range of care networks, community providers and cross-sector agencies to advance a partnership strategy that is integrated and outcome-focused
* Support performance oversight of the cancer system in the region (including performance of volumes, data, access safety and quality) and lead efforts to improve regional performance
* Champion provincial cancer standards to ensure these are put into practice at the point of care, through dissemination of standards and compliance monitoring
* Support the RVP to oversee cancer related funding within the RCP, assessing existing capacity and developing strategies to optimize regional resources
* Collaborate and liaise with OH-CCO and the Regional Directors throughout the province through participation and leadership on provincial committees and projects with the goal to advance the overall care experience for persons with cancer in our community

**Qualifications**
The successful candidate will possess the following experience, skills, attributes, and capabilities:
  
  

* Master's degree in health administration, Health Sciences, Business Administration, or related field
* Minimum 5–7 years of progressive leadership experience within a complex healthcare environment, preferably within oncology
* Experience within the Ontario cancer system and strong knowledge of regional service delivery models is considered an asset
* Demonstrated proficiency in strategic and operational planning, management principles and business case development
* Knowledge of quality improvement methodologies, financial practices and risk management principles
* Demonstrated strong analytical skills
* Demonstrated excellence in communication, stakeholder engagement, facilitation, and relationship management
* History of building constructive and effective relationships and gaining credibility in other organizations and within those organizations across disciplines, divisions, departments and programs
* Demonstrated ability to think strategically and implement sophisticated programs and initiatives
* Excellent oral and written communication skills
* Highly motivated and enthusiastic team player who thrives in ambiguity
* Strong influencer, ability to listen, mediate and negotiate
* Demonstrated experience in supervising professionals and team building
* Change management and project management skills a strong asset

**Position Overview**

The Director, Global Customer Experience is responsible for building, leading, and continuously strengthening Blink Energy’s global Customer Success organization. This leader manages and develops a team of Customer Experience leaders who, in turn, lead Customer Success Manager teams responsible for the complete customer relationship.

Customer Success Managers serve as the customer’s named partner from the point of sale through onboarding, deployment, and ongoing service, coordinating across Sales, Operations, Field Services, Technical Support, Engineering, Product, and Finance to deliver clear ownership, proactive communication, and measurable value.

**Strengthen Strategic Customer Management**

* Ensure Customer Success Manager teams build trusted relationships with customer stakeholders, ranging from operational contacts to executive sponsors.
* Establish standards for account plans, success plans, stakeholder maps, relationship strategies, and documented customer objectives.
* Serve as an executive sponsor for Blink Energy’s most strategic, complex, or at-risk customer relationships.
* Maintain executive-level awareness of customer health, commitments, risks, business outcomes, and emerging needs.

* Establish a consistent global framework for Quarterly Service Reviews and Executive Business Reviews.

* Require root-cause analysis and corrective action for significant or recurring customer issues.
* Measure whether recovery actions restore customer confidence, not simply whether the immediate ticket is closed.

**Establish Customer Health and Performance Management**

* Define a global customer health framework using operational, relationship, product, support, financial, and engagement indicators.
* Establish dashboards and management routines that provide visibility into portfolio health, onboarding status, escalations, adoption, service performance, and customer risk.
* Create clear intervention thresholds for at-risk accounts and hold leaders accountable for documented recovery plans.
* Improve the quality and consistency of customer data within CRM and Customer Success platforms.
* Provide regular reporting to executive leadership on customer outcomes, emerging risks, performance trends, organizational capacity, and required decisions.

**Champion the Voice of the Customer**

* Build a structured global Voice of the Customer program that converts customer feedback into prioritized business action.
* Bring customer insight to Product, Engineering, Operations, Sales, Marketing, and executive leadership with clarity and supporting evidence.
* Establish closed-loop processes so customers and internal stakeholders understand what action was taken in response to feedback.
* Influence product roadmaps, service-delivery priorities, operational improvements, and customer communication strategies.
* Partner with Marketing and Sales to develop customer advocates, references, case studies, testimonials, and industry participation opportunities.

Event and Theatre, and Hospitality Services (ETHS) is a division of the Finance and Commercial Operations area of Mount Royal University (MRU). **About the Role**
==================

The Manager, Conference and Events provides strategic leadership, operational oversight, and financial management for theatre and conference operations, institutional events, commercial bookings, and internal functions hosted across Mount Royal University. Operating within the Department of Events, Theatre, and Hospitality Services, this position oversees multi-venue operations, including the world-class Taylor Centre for Performing Arts (Bella Concert Hall, TransCanada Amphitheatre, and supporting spaces), Ross Glen Hall (RGH), and campus meeting spaces. The Manager leads a team dedicated to meeting the distinct needs of performing arts and internal and external conference clients, delivering high-quality event experiences, maximizing facility utilization, driving revenue generation, and upholding MRU’s reputation as a premier host institution for local, national, and international events.

Reporting directly to the Director, Events, Theatre, and Hospitality Services, the Manager operates with a high degree of independence, strategic discretion, and administrative authority. The Manager operates in a fast-paced, highly variable environment characterized by competing deadlines, complex event schedules, and dynamic stakeholder needs.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

### **Strategic Event Operations & Venue Management**

* Direct the end-to-end operational planning, scheduling, and execution of all external and internal conferences, performances, and institutional events across campus, with specialized operational leadership over the spaces within the Taylor Centre for Performing Arts and the RGH.
* Establish and monitor service delivery standards, workflow processes, and quality assurance metrics to ensure seamless client and audience experiences.
* Collaborate with internal service partners (Catering, Technical Production, IT, Building Services, Security) to coordinate cross-functional event logistics.
* Support the Manager, Hospitality and Guest Services in overseeing catering sales, coordination, and service delivery across MRU, working with the catering vendor to meet institutional and client expectations.

### **Team Leadership & Talent Management**

* Lead, recruit, mentor, and evaluate the event coordination team, working closely with the Manager, Hospitality and Guest Services to coordinate front-of-house support for events.
* Manage performance, foster continuous learning, set clear performance objectives, and create a culture of accountability and customer-service excellence.
* Manage scheduling, work distribution, and overtime in alignment with the MRSA Collective Agreement and institutional guidelines.

### **Business Development, Client Relations & Financial Oversight**

* Develop and execute business development strategies to drive venue rentals, commercial bookings, and theatre and conference growth, particularly maximizing utilization of the Taylor Centre for Performing Arts and the RGH.
* Prepare and manage annual operating budgets, revenue targets, pricing models, and client contracts.
* Build and maintain relationships with corporate clients, community partners, arts organizations, and internal campus organizers.

### **Risk Management, Compliance & Continuous Improvement**

* Oversee event risk assessments, licensing where required (excluding liquor), liability management, and safety protocols for all managed spaces.
* Analyze post-event metrics, client feedback, and financial returns to drive process improvements and service enhancements.
* Maintain thorough knowledge of and adhere to MRU safety systems, policies, procedures, and safe work guidelines.

------------------

* Bachelor’s Degree in Event Management, Hospitality Management, Business Administration, Performing Arts Administration, or a related field.
* Certified Meeting Professional (CMP) or Certified Special Events Professional (CSEP) designation is considered an asset.
* Experience working in high volume hospitality is considered an asset.
* Minimum 7 to 10 years of progressive management experience in conference services, venue operations, or large-scale event management, preferably within a post-secondary or performing arts complex environment.
* Proven track record in venue sales, client contract negotiation, revenue generation, and financial management.
* Demonstrated leadership experience managing direct reports and flexible event teams within a unionized environment.
* Advanced knowledge of conference management systems, venue scheduling software, and event ticketing systems.
* Working knowledge of performing arts venue operations, including artist and promoter requirements and coordination with technical and front-of-house teams.
* Exceptional interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills with strong negotiation and conflict resolution capabilities.
* Ability to work flexible schedules, including frequent evenings and weekends based on event schedules.

**Your Role And Responsibilities**
IBM/Confluent is searching for a Customer Success Technical Architect (CSTA) to act as a trusted technical advisor and advocate to work with our customers. The primary objective of this role is to ensure the success, retention & expansion of our customers by providing technical guidance, including best practices, for the Confluent product suite. You will partner with others in Customer Solutions as well as cross-functional divisions such as Sales, Product Management and Engineering to help our customers accelerate time to value, maximize product consumption and achieve their overall business objectives.
  
  
The CSTA role is both deeply technical and commercial in nature. You will leverage a technical background (e.g. AppDev, SysAdmin, Distributed Computing) to advise customers on their architectures, including patterns & strategies for operating and maturing their Confluent subscription. You will also utilize relationship management skills & industry experience to guide the customer on how they can best achieve their business goals and value-based outcomes via their Confluent investment.
  
  
In this role, you will have the opportunity to build broad experience with Kafka, Flink and Confluent IP as well as gain an understanding of complementary and competitive technologies. You will work with a variety of organizations ranging from new start-ups to large enterprise customers. Locations: US Remote

* When necessary, roll up your sleeves and dig in to help address customer issues alongside Confluent Technical Support Engineers and Core Engineering.

* Passion for working on complex technical problems, with a strong understanding of modern infrastructure and streaming technologies; self starter who loves a fast-paced environment
* Excellent interpersonal & communication skills and an ability to concisely explain tricky issues and complex solutions to a variety of personas
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple customers at a time while paying strict attention to detail and delivering results across multiple initiatives such as driving expansion, customer satisfaction, feature adoption, and retention
* Collaborative spirit, outstanding consulting & relationship management skills and ability to rapidly switch context

* Strategic Thinking: Experience in developing industry insights and solutions that drive business value and address pressing industry challenges, with the ability to think strategically and tailor guidance to client needs.

Maestro, our AI-powered underwriting platform, already runs inside nesto, with AI agents making real-time, policy-based decisions. We are now bringing it to financial institution clients through Nesto Cloud. You will be the first leader of client AI delivery. Your mission is to run the program that puts a fleet of AI agents live in Canadian banks’ production environments. As our Director of AI Delivery, you'll own it end to end: the delivery plan, the pod, the day-to-day client relationship, and the evidence that moves each agent through requirements, testing, model-risk approval, live-file shadow, joint change management, and progressive production activation. You will also write the repeatable deployment playbook we reuse for every client that follows.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Lead Maestro delivery. Set a clear delivery approach amid uncertainty and build trust with client executives.
* Own the plan and stage exits. Own the plan across underwriting agents. Call each stage exit against its written proof point across our 9 stages: scoping, process mapping, golden sets, configuration, evaluation, model governance, shadow, change management, and progressive production decisioning.
* Lead the pod. Lead a senior delivery pod (delivery managers, underwriting expert, data scientists, program PM) day to day. Guide the AI Delivery Managers as they gather requirements for each agent. Work with the assigned PM and the relevant delivery and technical colleagues to keep implementations moving. Run standups and working sessions, and build and defend the steering narrative. The client Sponsor makes the final call on the story.
* Chair eval review. Run the weekly review of agent performance evidence and turn it into build and tuning priorities for Engineering. Data Scientists produce the evidence. You review it and do not produce it yourself.
* Lead the model-risk relationship. Lead the relationship with the client’s model-risk team. Land validation packages for each condition family and secure the risk and governance sign-offs that authorize shadow and production.
* Run the shadow program. Adjudicate divergences, re-validate for drift, and report value foregone to client executives each month.
* Own change management and readiness. Co-own the joint readiness sign-off with the client and make sure the pilot group is trained and running the new workflow.
* Build the deployment playbook. Write the repeatable process that takes AI agents from client requirements through testing and client approval into production. Document each agent’s deployment as you go. The playbook is a core deliverable, not a retrospective.
* Protect scope. Hold client “small asks” to the config log and SOW change process. Nothing gets absorbed silently.

**What You Bring**

* You have a client-facing delivery background, as an engagement manager, Delivery Director, or Implementation Director.
* You have run senior delivery teams on client sites and led working sessions with EVP-level executives.
* You have led client AI implementations hands-on, from requirements through production.
* You know ML/AI delivery well enough to chair an eval review, question precision and recall trade-offs, and translate model evidence into language a risk committee can act on.
* You define written exit criteria, produce the artifacts that back them, and document decisions.

****Nice-to-Have****

* Experience implementing AI for banks or other regulated organizations, including model-risk validation.
* Experience implementing your own company’s product at the client.
* Mortgage or retail-credit domain knowledge, or experience with staged production rollouts of decisioning systems.
* Comfort building the playbook while running it in a scale-up.

****This Role Might Be for You If****

* You have delivered AI solutions for enterprise clients on high-visibility projects and know how to earn their stakeholders’ trust.
* You get energized when there is no playbook to follow and can turn uncertainty into a clear, structured approach.
* You do well under high expectations on a project that matters deeply to the client.
* You work well with a growing team of delivery, product, and technical colleagues.

The Director, Program Delivery will also be expected to support program execution through the coaching of project and program managers on risks and issues which may impact program delivery and performance.
