The Red Hat Hybrid Platforms Product Management team is looking for a Principal Product Manager (technical) to own and drive identity solutions in Red Hat OpenShift.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
In this role, you are responsible for how people, workloads, and software agents authenticate to OpenShift and how OpenShift decides what they are allowed to do. You will work with the Engineering and Product teams who build and deliver those capabilities. The product area includes:
  
  

* User authentication and authorization, including the OpenShift OAuth server and external OpenID Connect integrations, Kubernetes RBAC, workload identity, multi-cluster authentication on OpenShift clusters
* Identity and user federation to secure agentic workflows in OpenShift.

You will plan and deliver product content for new releases and launches, prioritize and communicate requirements to guide development, support the field in advanced sales opportunities, perform competitive reviews, and work with partners. You will contribute to company strategy and work closely with Engineering, Marketing, Support, Sales, Security, and Field teams.
  
  
You will engage with the open source communities behind this work, including Kubernetes and other Cloud Native Computing Foundation (CNCF) projects.
  
  
As a Principal Product Manager, you need great communication, teamwork, and persuasion skills to articulate the product vision, align teams across the company, and influence stakeholders. This is an opportunity to work on a core platform control alongside some of the brightest minds in open source.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Collect input from OpenShift users, customers, community members, and internal stakeholders on how enterprises manage identity, and turn that input into strategy and a roadmap
* Define the product vision, the customer problems to solve, and measurable outcomes for authentication, authorization, and workload identity.
* Define and use metrics for adoption and measuring success
* Research commercial and do-it-yourself alternatives and use that research for competitive positioning
* Prioritize and document requirements, epics, and user stories, with acceptance criteria, for new releases
* Guide major enhancements with OpenShift Engineering, Kubernetes upstream, and adjacent product teams.
* Drive the identity model that agentic features in OpenShift and related products use, and work with those product teams so agents obtain authority through OpenShift identity and authorization
* Work with Sales on customer inquiries, presentations, and demos.
* Support go-to-market work, including presentations, blogs, demos, workshops, events, and sales enablement, and review documentation for this area
* Keep Engineering, Support, and Field aligned on direction, and own the translation of strategy into a release plan

**What You Will Bring**

* 5+ years of enterprise software experience in product management, technical marketing, solutions engineering, or a similar technical product or customer-facing role
* A track record of leading cross-functional work on a platform, security, or identity management, and of influencing people who do not report to you
* Direct experience with Kubernetes identity management.
* Working knowledge of OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect, and or how enterprises use identity provider (e.g. Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, Ping Federate).
* Working knowledge of cloud workload identity. Depth in at least one of the following, and literacy in the others: AWS STS, Microsoft Entra workload identity, and Google Workload Identity or Workload Identity Federation
* A clear view of how a typical enterprise uses identity: single sign-on, group-based access, joiner-mover-leaver, non-human identities, and short-lived credentials as the default
* A clear view of how identity should work for agentic AI.
* Linux skills and direct experience with Linux containers and Kubernetes
* Working knowledge of the CNCF ecosystem and experience with open source projects
* Demonstrated ability to listen to customers, stakeholders, and engineering and turn that into product decisions
* Ability to handle several competing priorities
* Bachelor's or graduate degree in computer science, engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience
* Excellent written and verbal communication
* Willingness to travel up to 25%

**The Following Are Considered a Plus**

* Hands-on configuration of OpenShift identity providers, OAuth, external OpenID Connect, or cloud credential modes used by managed OpenShift
* Upstream participation in Kubernetes SIG Auth or a related CNCF project
* Experience with SPIFFE and SPIRE, LDAP, or Active Directory
* Understanding of zero trust principles.
* Experience with compliance programs in which identity is a control, such as FedRAMP or PCI
* Prior experience with agile delivery and with Jira or a similar tool
* A track record of enterprise product launches

**What You Will Do**
Our customers want to make AI their own: their model, their data, their AI.
  
  
Help customers make frontier and open models their own
  
  

* Lead model selection, optimization and serving decisions on Red Hat AI: vLLM, llm-d, LLM Compressor, the validated model catalog, and hardware profiles across NVIDIA, AMD and other accelerators.
* Baseline and reduce inference cost per use case (cost per million tokens, GPU utilization) using GuideLLM benchmarks and recipe-based optimization, and decide with evidence whether to prompt, ground or tune a model for a task.
* Design portable inference: workloads that move between cloud APIs, on-premises clusters and sovereign environments without re-architecture.
* Travel weekly, Monday-Thursday, to client locations

Ground and evaluate on the customer's terms, in the customer's environment

* Lead sovereign and disconnected deployments of Red Hat AI on OpenShift, including model provenance, signing, AI bills of materials and compliance evidence.

Run it as a service, and run operations with it
  
  

* Design and stand up Models-as-a-Service and GPU-as-a-Service on OpenShift AI and Red Hat AI Enterprise: multi-tenancy, the AI gateway, metering, showback and chargeback, self-service accelerator access.
* Build agentic systems that operate infrastructure through Ansible Automation Platform: patching, CVE remediation, upgrades, supply-chain attestation and incident remediation, with every action passing through RBAC, approval and audit.

Lead the engagement and leave it better
  
  

* Own the architecture and the delivery plan on engagements from two-week baselines to multi-month service builds and lighthouse programs; set the success metric with the customer's sponsor and hold the team to it.
* Pair with and certify customer engineers so the result keeps running after we leave.
* Turn each delivery into a reusable asset for the practice: runbooks, reference architectures, harnesses and recipes, and feed product gaps back to Red Hat engineering with evidence.
* Represent Red Hat's point of view on enterprise AI with CTOs, platform leaders and FinOps teams, and support sellers in scoping results that can be dated with confidence.
* Provide customer feedback to internal teams to enhance product offerings and services.
* Lead internal initiatives that foster innovation, efficiency, and growth within the Services business.
* Continuously learn, grow, and adapt to new skills and technologies
* Regular travel to client locations, up to weekly according to project needs

**What You Bring**

* 10+ years in enterprise technology, with at least 5 as a hands-on architect or senior consultant delivering in customer environments.
* Deep, current OpenShift expertise: cluster architecture, GitOps, multi-cluster management, security and observability, GPU-enabled nodes; Red Hat Certified Architect or equivalent demonstrated depth.
* Production experience with Red Hat AI or its upstreams: OpenShift AI, vLLM, model serving with KServe, model registries and pipelines, and at least one of llm-d, LLM Compressor or Eval Hub.
* Working knowledge of how enterprises run generative AI today: inference economics, model selection and optimization, RAG and evaluation, agent frameworks and harnesses, MCP, and the governance and cost pressures that shape production decisions.
* Application development fluency on Kubernetes: containers, APIs, CI/CD and the trusted software supply chain (SBOM, signing, policy gates), in at least one of Python, Go or Java.
* Automation with Ansible Automation Platform, including event-driven automation, or an equivalent you can map onto it quickly.
* A record of leading engagements to a measurable result on a date, and of leaving customer teams able to run what you built.
* Clear writing and speaking for technical and executive audiences; comfortable setting a success metric with a sponsor and reporting against it.

**Preferred**

* Agent development in production: tool calling, agent identity and delegation, sandboxed execution, agent observability and evaluation; contributions to MCP, A2A, Llama Stack, LangGraph, Kagenti or similar.
* Experience designing Models-as-a-Service or GPU-as-a-Service for shared platform teams: multi-tenancy, gateways, metering, showback and chargeback, scheduling with Kueue or Run:ai.
* FinOps for AI: building cost baselines, unit economics per use case, and verifying savings on a customer's own hardware.
* Sovereign, regulated or disconnected deployments; familiarity with EU AI Act obligations and model provenance requirements.
* Model customization: fine-tuning and post-training, synthetic data generation, and the judgment to know when prompting or grounding is the better answer.
* Open source contribution and community standing in projects Red Hat leads or sponsors.
* Prior forward-deployed, residency or customer-engineering work at a platform or model company.

**Lead Product Management & Develop – Wireline Transformation and Legacy Product Retirement**

**Introduction**

Build a more connected world by transforming the customer experience and helping customers transition to modern products and technologies. Our Product teams help shape the future of connectivity by simplifying platforms, improving operations, and delivering solutions that meet evolving customer needs. In this role, you’ll lead strategic wireline transformation initiatives that retire legacy voice products, platforms, services, technologies, and processes. Your work will help protect service continuity, improve the migration experience, reduce operational complexity, and advance the business toward its target end state.

**Job overview**

As a Lead Product Manager for Wireline Transformation and Legacy Product Retirement, you’ll define and execute transformation roadmaps, develop product-sunset strategies, evaluate customer and business impacts, and coordinate customer migrations to target products and technologies.

You’ll partner closely with customer-care call centers and teams across network, engineering, operations, sales, marketing, finance, legal, regulatory, and corporate communications. Together, you’ll plan operational readiness, prepare customer-care representatives, develop internal and customer-facing communications, monitor performance, and establish feedback loops that support a consistent customer experience throughout each transition.

**What you’ll do**

* **Lead transformation and product-retirement strategy:** Define and communicate the wireline transformation strategy, roadmap, measurable outcomes, sunset milestones, dependencies, decision points, and readiness criteria for legacy products, platforms, technologies, services, and processes.
* **Plan customer migrations:** Segment affected customers, establish migration strategies, and define paths to target end-state products or technologies while managing customer retention, service continuity, and escalation risks.
* **Develop business cases and impact assessments:** Analyze customer, revenue, cost, network, operational, and state and federal regulatory impacts; create business cases supporting product retirement, platform simplification, and customer migration.
* **Prepare customer-care operations:** Partner with call-center leaders on contact-demand forecasting, staffing considerations, call-flow planning, operational readiness, and escalation paths. Coordinate agent procedures, training, product-transition guidance, knowledge articles, frequently asked questions, call scripts, and job aids.
* **Coordinate communications and technical execution:** Develop internal and customer-facing communication plans with customer care, marketing, sales, legal, regulatory, corporate communications, engineering, network, and other stakeholders. Address technical dependencies and decommissioning requirements while keeping representatives informed about milestones, offers, migration options, policy changes, and known issues.
* **Manage governance, risk, and performance:** Lead cross-functional governance, resolve escalations, and manage risks involving billing, ordering, revenue, service continuity, operational readiness, customer migration, and escalation resolution. Track and report migration progress, customer retention, contact volume, customer sentiment, cost savings, and decommissioning progress to senior leadership.

**What you’ll need**

* **Product-sunset and migration planning:** Experience building and executing complex product-retirement, customer-migration, or technology-transformation plans.
* **Wireline and telecommunications knowledge:** Understanding of wireline products, network technologies, service delivery, and related operational processes.
* **Business-case and roadmap development:** Ability to develop business cases, prioritize initiatives, define roadmaps, and establish measurable milestones and readiness criteria.
* **Data analysis:** Ability to interpret customer, financial, revenue, cost, operational, network, and product-performance data and translate findings into recommendations.
* **Contact-center operational planning:** Experience supporting demand forecasting, call-flow planning, workforce considerations, knowledge management, training, communications, and escalation processes.
* **Risk and dependency management:** Ability to manage cross-functional dependencies and risks involving service continuity, customer migration, billing, ordering, revenue, operational readiness, and platform decommissioning.

**What you’ll bring**

* **Education or equivalent experience:** Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience.
* **Relevant experience:** Approximately 5–8 years of product management, business transformation, telecommunications, or related experience.
* **Transformation leadership:** Experience managing complex product-sunset, customer-migration, or technology-transformation initiatives.
* **Customer-care partnership:** Experience partnering with customer-care or contact-center organizations on operational planning, training, and communications.
* **Cross-functional leadership:** Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder-management skills, with demonstrated success managing competing priorities, dependencies, risks, escalations, and senior-leadership updates.
* **Preferred experience:** Knowledge of consumer wireline products, customer lifecycle management, service migrations, or transformation programs. Familiarity with call-center operations, workforce planning, knowledge management, agent training, and contact-volume forecasting is preferred, along with experience creating customer communications, agent scripts, frequently asked questions, job aids, and escalation procedures.

Help shape the future of wireline connectivity by making complex transitions easier for customers and the teams that support them. You’ll have the opportunity to lead high-impact transformation programs, collaborate across the organization, and deliver measurable improvements in customer experience, operational efficiency, and platform simplification.

* Strong storytelling skills, with excellent written and verbal communication

We are looking for an experienced and highly analytical Senior Manager, Credit Risk Strategy, Acquisition to lead the development and optimization of credit card acquisition strategies.

This role will have end-to-end accountability for acquisition credit risk strategy, from identifying opportunities and conducting advanced analytics through strategy design, implementation, testing, and ongoing performance monitoring. The successful candidate will play a key leadership role in balancing portfolio growth, credit quality, profitability, and customer experience.

  

**What you will do:**

  

**Acquisition strategy ownership:**

* Lead the development, implementation, and ongoing optimization of credit card acquisition credit risk strategies, including credit eligibility, approval/decline criteria, score cut-offs, credit assignment, and risk-based segmentation.
* Own acquisition strategy performance and continuously identify opportunities to improve approval rates, portfolio growth and profitability while maintaining credit losses within risk appetite.
* Develop differentiated strategies across customer segments, channels, products.
* Establish a robust champion/challenger framework to test new strategies, cut-offs, segmentation approaches, and decisioning methodologies.
* Monitor new-account vintages and cohorts to identify emerging risks and ensure acquisition quality remains aligned with portfolio objectives and loss expectations.

**Advanced analytics & strategy development:**

* Translate analytical findings into clear, actionable credit strategies and business recommendations.
* Partner with modelling team to evaluate and implement credit bureau attributes, internal data, alternative data, credit scores and predictive models.
* Evaluate new data sources and analytical techniques that can improve risk differentiation and reduce unnecessary declines.
* Develop measurement frameworks to quantify the incremental impact of strategy changes on accounts, balances, revenue, expected losses and profitability.
* Credit decisioning & technology
* Provide leadership and subject-matter expertise for acquisition decisioning platforms and modernization initiatives.
* Partner closely with Technology to ensure accurate implementation, testing and deployment.
* Establish appropriate strategy governance, documentation, quality assurance and post-production validation controls.
  

**Portfolio oversight & risk management:**

* Monitor acquisition performance across key risk and business metrics, including approval rate, credit quality, early delinquency, losses, utilization, balance growth and profitability.
* Identify emerging risks, trends and opportunities and proactively recommend strategy changes.
* Ensure acquisition strategies operate within established risk appetite, policies and governance requirements.
* Partner with Finance on forecasting and planning to quantify the expected impact of acquisition strategies on portfolio growth, revenue and credit losses.
* Develop clear reporting and executive-level recommendations on strategy performance and emerging credit trends.
  

**Leadership & collaboration:**

* Lead, coach and develop a high-performing team of credit risk strategy and analytics professionals.
* Establish analytical standards and provide guidance on strategy design, testing, implementation and performance measurement.
* Partner closely with Product, Marketing, Finance, Technology, Operations, Data teams to ensure acquisition initiatives achieve both growth and risk objectives.
* Influence senior stakeholders by translating complex analytical findings into clear business recommendations.
* Lead major acquisition initiatives from initial concept and business case through implementation and performance validation.
  

**What you bring:**

* Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Finance, Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or another quantitative discipline. Master's degree is an asset.
* 7+ years of experience in credit risk, consumer lending, credit strategy, portfolio management or a closely related analytical discipline, with significant experience in credit card acquisition/origination strategy.
* 3+ years of people leadership or demonstrated leadership of complex analytical initiatives.
* Strong hands-on analytical experience with SQL, Python, Power BI.
* Experience working with credit decisioning platforms such as ACE/ADM or comparable decision engines is a must.
* Strong understanding of champion/challenger testing, experimental design, strategy validation and performance monitoring.
* Proven ability to convert complex analytical findings into practical strategies and communicate recommendations to senior leadership.
* Strong business judgment and ability to balance growth, customer experience, profitability and credit risk.
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives involving Risk, Product, Marketing, Finance and Technology.
* Highly motivated self-starter who can operate effectively in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple complex priorities.

Le/la
**gestionnaire, prestation de services**
est responsable de développer, de diriger et de mener à bien l’initiative stratégique « Capsule » du Service Entreprise, qui est nécessaire pour mettre en œuvre la solution technique ayant été élaborée pour les clients Rogers. Il doit également mettre l’emphase sur la gestion d’une transition harmonieuse de la solution technique du service des Ventes vers l’équipe Implantation client. Son rôle consiste aussi à identifier et à résoudre des problèmes pouvant gêner la progression des processus d’approvisionnement, et à s’engager personnellement avec le client pour établir des attentes et fournir des mises à jour officielles sur les progrès.
  
  
**Responsabilités**

* Assurer l’intégration de nouveaux clients lors de déploiements importants et gérer leurs attentes du début à la fin.
* Améliorer le service Entreprise et l’expérience client en assumant la pleine responsabilité de l’implantation intégrale de la solution de service destinée au client.
* Recueillir des renseignements sur les commandes afin de les entrer dans le système de Rogers et de gérer le cycle d’approvisionnement d’une commande de la réception à la facturation.
* Prendre en charge l’expérience client en s’assurant que les actions appropriées soient posées tout au long du processus, agir en tant que point de contact central pour le client et pour l’équipe des ventes.
* Diriger des réunions quotidiennes avec les équipes Implantation client dans le but de conduire des activités de collaboration entre des employés occupant différents postes et possédant différentes expertises. Ces réunions ont lieu au début et tout au long du processus d’approvisionnement afin d’aborder de manière proactive les défis qui peuvent avoir une incidence sur le respect des délais d’approvisionnement du service.
* Fournir du coaching et du soutien aux différents acteurs qui composent l’équipe de réalisation de projets chargée de rendre possible une solution de service au client.
* Établir et entretenir des relations constructives avec les membres de l’équipe, les SME, les intervenants et les autres membres de l’entreprise.
* Prendre des décisions d’affaires cruciales visant à répondre aux attentes du client.
* Comprendre la stratégie d’affaire des chefs principaux et fournir des recommandations liées aux projets afin d’offrir un service rentable.
* Superviser la réalisation des tâches et des étapes d’implantation détaillées dans les documents portant sur la technologie et l’ingénierie ainsi que dans les énoncés de travaux avec les partenaires en impartition.
* Comprendre les problèmes (techniques, liés aux processus, etc.) et surmonter les obstacles jalonnant toutes les zones opérationnelles pour s’assurer qu’une commande exécutable est activée à chaque étape du processus d’approvisionnement afin de fournir au client le service dans les délais prévus.
* Identifier les obstacles ainsi que les conflits et évaluer, recommander et implémenter des solutions réalisables. Effectuer les recours hiérarchiques nécessaires des problèmes aux échelons appropriés au sein de l’entreprise afin d’atténuer les risques et de faire en sorte que le processus d’approvisionnement se poursuive.
* Prendre des engagements au sujet des dates d’approvisionnement des clients.
* Assurer la gestion active des activités en cours et la prévision des revenus mensuels.
* Développer le plan du projet dans les délais impartis.
* Fournir aux dirigeants et aux gestionnaires des rapports précis sur les progrès de l’implantation, les problèmes, les risques ainsi que les plans d’urgence et d’amélioration.
* Élaborer et effectuer des présentations à des gestionnaires de différents niveaux, au besoin.

* Comprendre les principes fondamentaux et être en mesure d’implanter des projets intégrés/des stratégies de programme
* Titre de PMP (Spécialiste de la gestion de projet) un atout.
* Diplôme universitaire et certification professionnelle (p. ex., informatique, commerce, AC, ingénierie professionnelle, CGA, baccalauréat en éducation, en droit, etc.).
* Diplôme d’études postsecondaires en ingénierie ou toute autre discipline technique ou combinaison équivalente de formation ou d’expérience.
* Connaissance de la technologie et de la topologie Ethernet, de la technologie de protocole IP, du protocole d’ouverture de session (SIP) et MPLS.
* Connaissances approfondies des services et équipements de télécommunications.
* Trois à cinq années d’expérience au sein d’un environnement ou d’un secteur relié aux opérations des télécommunications.
* Connaissance des services du groupe Affaires de Rogers, des produits et des procédures.
* Éducation postsecondaire dans un domaine lié à la technologie ou les télécommunications.
* La certification ITIL (Bibliothèque pour l’infrastructure des technologies de l’information) est un atout.
* Maîtrise de Microsoft Word et d’Excel.

* This role requires to be in office 5 days/week.

The Marketing Operations Manager is responsible for the operational execution, governance, reporting, and optimization of marketing-generated leads and campaigns across Rogers Business. This role serves as a subject matter expert for Salesforce, lead management processes, campaign execution, reporting and analytics, and data governance.
  
  
Working cross-functionally with Marketing, Sales, Sales Operations, Product, Digital, and Technology teams, the incumbent ensures that campaigns are successfully launched, leads are accurately managed and routed, reporting is reliable, and business stakeholders receive actionable insights to support revenue growth.
  
  
This position plays a critical role in supporting growth initiatives across Enterprise, SMB, Dealer/Partner, Retail, Digital, and Base programs while driving continuous improvement of lead management platforms, processes, and reporting capabilities.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Campaign Operations & Execution**

* Manage end-to-end campaign operations for marketing and sales programs.
* Support campaign intake, requirements gathering, prioritization, and execution planning.
* Coordinate campaign launches across multiple channels and business units.
* Ensure campaigns are executed accurately and on time.
* Support major revenue-generating initiatives including acquisition, upsell, cross-sell, retention, migration, serviceability, and partner programs.

**Salesforce Administration & Lead Management**

* Act as the business lead and subject matter expert for Lead Management within Salesforce.
* Maintain campaign structures, lead routing rules, ownership processes, and automation workflows.
* Design and implement process improvements that improve reporting accuracy and sales execution.
* Manage lead ownership governance.
* Support Salesforce enhancements, releases, testing, and adoption initiatives.
* Work closely with Sales Operations and Technology teams to improve CRM functionality and user experience.

**Data Governance & Quality Management**

* Establish and maintain standards for lead quality, campaign attribution, and Salesforce data integrity.
* Conduct data validation, cleansing, segmentation, and campaign readiness reviews.
* Manage lead distribution and assignment processes across multiple sales organizations.
* Identify and resolve data quality issues impacting campaign execution and reporting.

**Process Improvement & Automation**

* Identify opportunities to automate manual operational processes.
* Partner with business and technical teams to build scalable solutions using Salesforce, Power Automate, Revenue.io, and related technologies.
* Support business transformation initiatives focused on improving campaign execution efficiency.
* Document processes, create operating procedures, and maintain operational standards.

**Stakeholder Management & Enablement**

* Serve as the primary operational liaison between Marketing, Sales, Analytics, Technology, and Sales Operations teams.
* Train and support users on lead management processes, Salesforce functionality, and reporting tools.
* Influence business decisions through data-driven recommendations and operational expertise.

**Qualifications**
**Experience**

* 5+ years experience in Marketing Operations, CRM Operations, Sales Operations, Lead Management, or Business Analytics.
* Experience supporting national sales and marketing organizations.
* Experience managing complex campaigns within Salesforce environments.
* Experience developing business reporting and dashboard solutions.

**Technical Skills**

* Advanced Salesforce CRM knowledge.
* Strong understanding of lead lifecycle management and campaign attribution.
* Power BI reporting and dashboard development.
* Advanced Excel and data analysis capabilities.
* Marketing automation platform experience.
* Process automation experience (Power Automate, workflow tools, CRM automations).

**Key Success Metrics**

* Campaign launches delivered on time.
* Lead volume and quality targets achieved.
* Salesforce data quality and compliance standards maintained.
* Campaign conversion and opportunity creation performance.
* Reporting accuracy and stakeholder satisfaction.
* Reduction in manual processes through automation.
* Revenue contribution from supported campaigns.
